title: A Study of RO7871996 in Participants with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
official: A Multicenter, Dose-Escalation and Dose-Finding, First-In-Human Study to Investigate Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Efficacy of Subcutaneously Administered RO7871996 in Participants with Active Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
summary:
Main objective: Single Ascending Dose (SAD), Multiple Ascending Dose (MAD)
To evaluate the safety and tolerability of single and multiple subcutaneous (SC) injections of RO7871996 in participants with active SLE
Phase 2:
To assess the clinical efficacy of RO7871996 and comparator treatment.

interventions.name: Gazyvaro 1,000 mg concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosed with SLE at least 24 weeks prior to informed consent, as assessed using the 2019 European League Against Rheumatism (EULAR)/American College of Rheumatology (ACR) Classification Criteria for SLE
2. Any of the following SLE autoantibodies within 5 years prior to the first screening visit or during screening: - positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) (titer ≥ 1:160), OR - anti-double-stranded DNA (anti-dsDNA) antibodies above the upper limit of normal (ULN), OR - anti-Smith antibody (anti-Sm) above ULN
3. Currently receiving one or more of the following classes of therapy for the treatment of SLE and fulfils the associated requirements: - Oral glucocorticoids ≤ 20 mg/day, prednisone or equivalent, and stable for at least 7 days prior to Day 1 - Conventional immunosuppressants (i.e., azathioprine, sulfasalazine, mycophenolate mofetil (MMF), mycophenolic acid, calcineurin inhibitor and methotrexate [oral, SC, or intramuscular routes]), stable for at least 6 weeks prior to Day 1 and expected to remain stable during the study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Severe active systemic autoimmune disease other than SLE
2. High risk for clinically significant bleeding
